title: SynthResult
description: Strict canonical contract for the synthesizer's output (Phase B step 8). Written to $WORKSPACE/synth_result.json. Phase B step 8.5 (verifier mini-round) may augment with a verification_round block; Phase B step 9 (render) consumes it to produce report.md. NOTE: phase-handoff.json#/definitions/synth_result is a deliberately permissive mirror used by main-session runtime parsing for backward-compat with pre-port workspaces. New synthesizer dispatches and contract tests should target this strict schema.

panel.description: Role names of the experts whose reports were synthesized. Strings only — not objects.

decisions.description: Trade-offs surfaced by the panel that the user must resolve. Each carries options + recommendation + rationale.

untouched_concerns.description: Topics one role flagged via out_of_scope that the owner role did not address. Single highest-value output of synth — single-reviewer baselines (plan-critic) cannot produce these.

dropped.description: Findings filtered as noise (generic best-practice without artifact evidence). Surfaced for transparency, not action.

skipped_experts.description: Roles whose dispatch failed twice and were marked skipped during step 7. Empty on the happy path.

correlated_bias_risk.description: True when ALL of: panel size >= 3, decisions.length == 0, untouched_concerns.length == 0, must_fix + should_fix >= 2. Flags echo-chamber risk; renderer surfaces a top-of-report banner.

evidence_thinness.description: Fraction of surviving findings (must + should + nice, post-filter) where evidence_source == reasoning. Renderer surfaces a banner when value >= 0.5 AND total findings >= 3.

disputed_findings.description: Findings where the adversarial round (step 7.5) produced a challenge that did not resolve to concede or refine. Empty when adversarial was skipped or all challenges resolved.

artifact_content_missing.description: Optional. True only when the input artifact_content was absent or empty and synth fell back to legacy prose-based pattern-matching for rule 5b. Coordinator may surface in a footer note.

verification_round.description: Added by Phase B step 8.5.resume — verifier mini-round summary. Not produced by the synthesizer itself; left optional in this schema.

synth_finding.description: A finding after synthesizer dedup + cross-confirm + downgrade arithmetic. Adds reporters[] and cross_confirmed on top of the per-expert ExpertReport finding shape.

reporters.description: Role(s) that originally reported this finding. >1 means cross_confirmed.
